parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client. It must be unique among different requests, is case-sensitive, and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the static user to be created.
